dict.string: Just Maple connects to Home Assistant on your home network to read the devices you exposed to assistants, and to change one only when you tap to confirm.
Just Maple records system audio when you enable system audio recording.
Maple reads your contacts so bots know who people are.

Just Maple reads only the Health data you choose (steps, exercise, sleep, resting heart rate and workouts) to keep a daily summary that Maple’s assistant can use to answer questions about your activity. It never writes to Health.
Just Maple does not write to Health. It only reads the Health data you choose (steps, exercise, sleep, resting heart rate and workouts) to keep a daily summary for Maple’s assistant.
Just Maple notes the places you visit, even when the app is closed, so Maple’s assistant can remind you when it’s time to leave. It uses Apple’s low-power visit detection, not continuous GPS.
